recs.title: Recommendations
recs.desc: Choose which recommendation features members can use. The shared similarity model is updated nightly while either option is on.
recs.personalized_desc: Show personalized mixes on the dashboard based on each member's activity.
recs.similar_desc: Show related works on book, audiobook, and series pages.
recs.overview_desc: Recommendations happen in three steps. First the system learns what each member enjoys, then it finds related works, and finally it removes poor or repetitive choices.
recs.step_taste_desc: Liking a work asks for more like it. Reading progress, completed works, and shelves add weaker clues.
recs.step_compare_desc: Every work is compared by meaning, authors, genres, tags, readers, and publisher.
recs.step_filter_desc: The strongest matches rise while finished, dismissed, and repetitive results are removed.
recs.similarity_score_desc: Each pair of works receives a weighted score. These weights are relative contributions, not probabilities.
recs.similarity_section_summary: The six signals used to compare two works
recs.similarity_notes: These six weights add up to 100%. Rare genres and tags matter more than broad ones. If meaning cannot be analyzed, the other weights are automatically rescaled.
recs.personalization_desc: Recent positive activity becomes a taste signal. Its starting influence is:
recs.personalization_notes: A like means you want more recommendations like that work. It is the strongest signal and acts as the 100% reference. Other actions are weaker, and every signal gradually loses influence as it gets older. Removing the like removes that preference.
recs.exclusions_summary: Finished, dismissed, or repetitive results are filtered out
recs.exclusion_consumed: Works you completed, started, or already placed on a shelf do not recommend themselves back to you.
recs.exclusion_feedback: “Not interested” hides that work and lowers similar works. Abandoning a work has a smaller negative effect.
recs.exclusion_diversity: Duplicate titles are removed, one author cannot dominate a mix, and a few places are kept for discovering something different.
recs.technical_summary: Exact ranking adjustments and decay values
recs.technical_ranking_value: 90% similarity · 5% popularity · 5% discovery · up to +10% taste-cluster match
recs.technical_live_value: Recent reading can add up to 8%. Repeated impressions can subtract up to 12%.
recs.technical_language_value: A known language mismatch reduces similarity by 70%.
recs.technical_decay_value: Positive signals retain about 37% after 90 days. Negative signals retain about 37% after 180 days.
recs.rebuild_desc: Recompute embeddings and similarities from scratch, then refresh every member's mixes. Slow on large libraries.
recs.refresh_feeds_desc: Recompute every member's mixes from their latest activity, reusing the existing similarity model. Takes seconds, not hours.

enrichment.title: Library metadata
enrichment.subtitle: Review how automatic enrichment matched your books, retry failures and fix mismatches.
enrichment.cooldown_strip: {provider} is rate-limited — retries resume in {minutes} min
enrichment.automatic_retry_summary: {provider} is temporarily busy. Automatic retry in {minutes} min.
enrichment.retry_exhausted_summary: {provider} did not respond after the automatic retries. You can retry manually.
enrichment.retry_cancelled_summary: Future automatic retries for {provider} were cancelled.
enrichment.retry_deferred: {count} book(s) queued. Providers cooling down: {providers}. They will continue automatically when it ends.
enrichment.no_state: This book has not been through enrichment yet.
enrichment.review_hint: This match wasn't clear-cut — the title matched loosely, or another candidate fit just as well. Confirm it's correct.
enrichment.ambiguous_hint: We found more than one valid match and applied neither. Choose the correct record.
enrichment.empty_no_match_desc: No unmatched books. Every book found a match.
enrichment.help_bucket_in_progress: Books the automatic pipeline is still working on. Nothing here needs you yet.
enrichment.help_bucket_attention: Books that stopped short of a confident match and need a decision from you.
enrichment.help_bucket_stopped: Books whose automatic enrichment you suspended. They stay put until you reprocess them.
enrichment.help_bucket_completed: Books matched and enriched. Kept here so you can spot-check the result.
enrichment.help_bucket_history: Books you retired from the tray. Their metadata is untouched.
enrichment.help_action_retry: Runs the providers again from the start, keeping fields you edited by hand.
enrichment.help_action_reprocess: Lifts the stop and queues the book for enrichment again.
enrichment.help_action_approve: Accepts the match as correct. The book moves to Completed and stops being asked about.
enrichment.help_action_stop: Suspends automatic retries. Nothing already saved is lost, and you can reprocess later.
enrichment.help_action_archive: Retires the book from the tray without touching its metadata. It also stops any scheduled retry.
enrichment.help_action_restore: Brings the book back from History as stopped, ready to reprocess.
enrichment.stop_confirm_body: Pending jobs and scheduled retries will be cancelled. Some jobs already running may still finish. This does not undo previously saved metadata.
enrichment.paused_banner: Automatic enrichment is paused for this library. Pending books won't run until you resume.
enrichment.empty_in_progress_desc: No books are being enriched right now.
enrichment.paused_banner_all: Automatic enrichment is paused for every library. Pending books won't run until you resume.
enrichment.providers_failed_summary: Some providers are failing across your libraries ({providers}). Pick a library to fix it.
enrichment.providers_failed_here: These providers found nothing in this library: {providers}.
enrichment.fix_providers_body: These providers have permanent failures in this library. Temporary failures and cooldowns are retried automatically.
enrichment.fix_providers_none: Select at least one provider to disable.
enrichment.fix_providers_reprocess: {count} affected book(s) will be reprocessed once.
enrichment.archive_confirm_body: They'll leave the work tray and move to History. The books and their saved metadata are not deleted — you can restore them anytime.
enrichment.no_field_origins: No fields have been filled by enrichment yet.
enrichment.empty_all_desc: No books are being tracked for metadata yet. They show up here as soon as a scan finds them.

read_listen.title: Read & Listen
read_listen.ebook_description: Pair this ebook with an audiobook to read while you listen.
read_listen.audiobook_description: Pair this audiobook with an ebook to read while you listen.
read_listen.dialog_description: Search publications you can access in this server.
read_listen.search_placeholder: Search by title, author, or filename
read_listen.type_to_search: Enter a title, author, or filename to search.
read_listen.no_matches: No accessible publications match this search.
read_listen.confirm_description: This pairing will be visible to everyone who can access both publications. It will not generate an alignment or send files to Modal.
read_listen.associate_failed: Unable to create the pairing. Check your access and try again.
read_listen.alignment_not_imported_description: No verified Honomiya alignment file has been imported for this pairing.
read_listen.alignment_stale_description: The ebook or audiobook changed after this alignment was imported.
read_listen.alignment_not_found: No Honomiya alignment file was found next to the ebook.
read_listen.alignment_invalid: The file next to the ebook is not a valid Honomiya alignment.
read_listen.alignment_source_mismatch: The alignment file was created from different ebook or audio files.
read_listen.alignment_detection_failed: Unable to inspect the alignment. Check that the server can read the source files and try again.
read_listen.generation_started: Honomiya generation started. You can leave this page while it runs.
read_listen.generation_already_running: This alignment is already being generated.
read_listen.generation_failed: The last Honomiya generation failed. You can try again.
read_listen.generation_start_failed: Unable to start generation. Check the Honomiya and Modal settings, then try again.
read_listen.sentence_seek_instructions: Book text. Use the arrow keys to choose a sentence, then press Enter to play from it.
read_listen.reader_unavailable: Unable to load the alignment. Return to the book and try again.
read_listen.remove_description: The ebook and audiobook will stay in your libraries. No reading or listening progress will be deleted.
read_listen.remove_failed: Unable to remove the pairing. Try again.
